jobs.title: Research Analyst - Technology, China Securities
jobs.descriptionText:
Position Purpose
Responsible for conducting equity research on aligned sectors with the aim of regular, timely and commercial recommendations on stocks for institutional investors.
Responsibilities
Direct Responsibilities
Cover stocks in designated Chinese sectors and build/maintain financial models on stocks under coverage with the purpose of providing regular, timely and commercial investment recommendations to clients.
Identify key investment themes in the sector and publish detailed reports on such themes with commercial recommendations for clients.
Produce equity research based on critical and thorough analysis
Interact regularly with internal and external clients to communicate key investment ideas.
Responsible for the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day to day business activities
Escalate any operational, compliance/legal and HR issues to line manager / compliance appropriately.
Permanent Control Aspects
Direct contribution to BNPP operational permanent control framework.
Contribute to the implementation of operational permanent control policies and procedures in day-to-day business activities, such as Control Plan
Comply with regulatory requirements and internal guidelines
Contribute to the reporting of all incidents according to the Incident Management System
Ensure audit recommendations are resolved within the specific timeline.
Technical & Behavioral Competencies
Strong analytical abilities and in-depth knowledge of designated Chinese sectors and the companies operating therein.
Thorough understanding of accounting, financial metrics and valuation techniques
Strong communication abilities in Mandarin and English
Ability to anticipate changes in thematic drivers that investors focus on
Be a team player and collaborate with other members of the research team and support other GBLs
Specific Qualifications (if Required)
Securities practitioner qualification is a must;
Securities Research Analyst certificate is a must
Professional qualification (e.g. CFA) shall be an added advantage

jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Tech Lead – Infrastructure Modernization & AI Engineering
Business： CTO Infrastructure, Asia & Middle East
Job ID：56478
About The Role
We are seeking a visionary, hands-on
Tech Lead
to spearhead the next-generation modernisation of our high-scale Hong Kong platforms and regional architecture. As part of HSBC’s core technology and digital transformation blueprint for the next four years, this role will drive the transition from legacy stacks to resilient in-house managed, build using open-source architectures, hybrid-cloud deployments, and secure, production-grade AI engineering capabilities.
You will own the infrastructure technical roadmap, engineering execution, and architectural integrity for mission-critical client and operational platforms, ensuring low-latency performance, strict regulatory alignment, and continuous delivery at scale.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Modernisation & Architecture:
Lead the end-to-end Infrastructure refactoring and migration of core legacy engines to modern, in-house built using open-source-aligned, hybrid-cloud architectures.
Implement scalable containerisation strategies (utilising advanced cluster networking and storage setups, e.g., Multus CNI integration) to handle heavy enterprise workloads.
Optimise high-throughput backend infrastructure, ensuring high availability, fault tolerance, and minimal technical debt across microservices.
AI & Data Engineering Integration:
Architect and scale the foundational infrastructure required to support high-density AI and data engineering workloads, including enterprise-grade GPU clusters, high-performance distributed storage, and low-latency networking fabrics.
Establish enterprise-wide AI-Ops and MLOps platforms that automate model deployment, scaling, monitoring, and lifecycle governance across hybrid-cloud environments.
Optimise large-scale data ingestion and storage pipelines to support petabyte-scale real-time data streaming and distributed database architectures without compromising core banking availability.
Engineering Excellence & Leadership:
Drive Agile delivery methodologies, replacing rigid release cycles with high-velocity minimum viable product (MVP) rollouts, rapid experimentation, and CI/CD automation.
Mentor and guide cross-functional software engineering teams, fostering a "fail-fast, learn-forward" engineering culture coupled with uncompromising production stability.
Collaborate closely with product owners, cybersecurity, risk, and regional stakeholders to align technical deliverables with strategic business outcomes.
Infrastructure Resilience & Cost Optimization:
Implement automated capacity planning, autoscaling, and intelligent resource allocation models to optimize infrastructure expenditure for heavy machine learning and analytics workloads.
Ensure high availability, disaster recovery readiness, and rigorous fault tolerance across all core AI serving endpoints and distributed data nodes.
Maintain strict infrastructure compliance, security hardening, and zero-trust network segmentation for all AI processing pipelines and training environments.
Requirements & Qualifications
Experience:
8+ years of software engineering experience within enterprise environments, with at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or principal architecture role.
Deep domain expertise in banking, fintech, or large-scale digital platform modernization.
Technical Stack:
Core Engineering: Advanced proficiency in modern backend languages (e.g., Java, Python, Go) and event-driven architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Cloud & Infrastructure: Extensive hands-on experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, cloud-native infrastructure, and complex network/storage plugins (such as Multus).
Data & AI: Demonstrated experience integrating LLMs/GenAI pipelines via APIs, vector databases, and enterprise data mesh/mastering frameworks under strict security protocols.
Methodologies:
Proven track record of executing large-scale code migration projects, reducing legacy footprints, and enforcing strict automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code (IaC).
Mindset:
Exceptional stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging deep technical concepts with executive business strategy in a fast-paced regional hub like Hong Kong.

jobs.descriptionText:
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled Senior DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving secure, reliable, and scalable DevOps capabilities that support application delivery, platform stability, and operational excellence across our global Financial Markets technology estate.
Key Responsibilities
Platform Engineering & Automation
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable secure, repeatable, and reliable software delivery
Automate build, deployment, configuration, and environment provisioning processes using modern DevOps tooling
Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions for cloud and on-premise platforms
Continuously improve deployment efficiency, environment consistency, scalability, and operational resilience
Technical Excellence
Apply engineering best practices for automation, observability, reliability, security, and maintainability
Participate in design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and continuous improvement of engineering practices
Implement automated testing, quality gates, vulnerability scanning, and compliance checks within delivery pipelines
Stay current with emerging DevOps, cloud, containerisation, and platform engineering practices
Collaboration & Communication
Work closely with application developers, SRE, QA, product managers, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders
Participate in agile delivery processes including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and release planning
Contribute to technical documentation, runbooks, knowledge sharing, and operational handover activities
Mentor engineers on DevOps practices, automation standards, release governance, and operational excellence
Quality & Compliance
Ensure delivery pipelines, environments, and operational processes meet security standards and regulatory requirements
Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, and incident response practices to improve service availability and recovery
Support performance, capacity, resiliency, and disaster recovery improvements for critical applications and platforms
Skills And Experience
CI/CD Pipeline Engineering
Infrastructure as Code
Containerisation and Orchestration
Cloud and Platform Operations
Observability and Incident Response
DevSecOps and Release Governance
Qualifications
Technical Skills
3-8 years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, release engineering, SRE, or infrastructure automation
Strong experience with CI/CD platforms and source control practices, including Git-based workflows
Proficiency in scripting and automation using tools such as Shell, Python, PowerShell, or Groovy
Experience with infrastructure as code and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, or similar
Working knowledge of containerisation and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes or OpenShift
Understanding of cloud platforms, Linux systems, networking fundamentals, security controls, and enterprise infrastructure patterns
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Splunk, or AppDynamics
Knowledge of automated testing, release governance, vulnerability scanning, and change management practices
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proactive approach to learning and professional development
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous
Preferred Requirements
Experience supporting highly available, business-critical applications in banking or financial services
Experience with site reliability engineering practices, incident management, service-level objectives, and production readiness
Cloud, Kubernetes, security, or DevOps certifications are advantageous
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What We Offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter,
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Developer to join our technology team and play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining robust, scalable backend systems that power Standard Chartered's digital banking platform. The successful candidate will lead technical initiatives, build platfrom 0-1, and contribute to architectural decisions that with major business impact to our global financial market business.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture
Design and develop high-performance, scalable backend services and APIs using modern technologies
Implement microservices architecture patterns and distributed system design principles
Ensure system reliability, performance, and security across all backend services
Drive adoption of best practices in code quality, testing, and deployment
Make architectural decisions and contribute to technical strategy and roadmap planning
Development & Implementation
Build robust RESTful APIs and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and related technologies
Implement secure, efficient database designs and optimize query performance
Develop event-driven architectures using messaging systems (Solace, Kafka)
Integrate with third-party systems and external APIs following banking industry standards
Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions
Collaboration & Communication
Work closely with front-end developers, SRE, QA, BA, product managers, and business stakeholders
Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback
Lead technical discussions and facilitate knowledge sharing sessions
Participate in technical interviews and contribute to team building initiatives
Quality & Compliance
Ensure all backend systems comply with banking regulations and security standards
Implement comprehensive testing strategies including unit, integration, and performance testing
Drive continuous improvement in development processes and methodologies
Maintain high standards of documentation for systems and processes
Support production systems and participate in on-call rotations when required
Skills And Experience
Java (Spring Boot)
Relational DB
MQ
Logging, Monitoring and Alerts
Design Pattern
API
Qualifications
Technical Expertise
5-8 years of experience in backend development with strong Java expertise
Proficiency in Spring Framework (Spring Boot)
Extensive experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (Redis)
Extensive experience with messaging systems (Solace, Apache Kafka)
Strong understanding of microservices architecture and distributed systems
Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience in CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
Experience with API design and development (REST, GraphQL)
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking capabilities
Experience working in agile development environments
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
Strong project management and organizational skills
Excellent communication skills with ability to explain complex technical concepts
Education & Certifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

jobs.title: Senior Test Automation Engineer
jobs.descriptionText:
Job Summary
Senior Test Automation Engineer
We are seeking a skilled Senior Test Automation Engineer to join our dynamic technology team. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust automated test suites across API and UI layers for mission-critical trading and financial applications, ensuring quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance across our global financial market business.
Key Responsibilities
Test Automation Strategy & Design
Design and implement scalable, maintainable automated test frameworks covering API, UI (web), and end-to-end (E2E) test layers
Translate business requirements and acceptance criteria into layered test strategies (unit / API / UI / E2E) and BDD-style Gherkin feature files
Define test data strategy, environment management, and test coverage standards aligned with product risk profile
Development & Implementation
Build and maintain automated test suites using industry-standard frameworks (e.g. Cucumber/BDD, Playwright, Selenium, REST-assured)
Implement API-level automation validating request/response contracts, business rules, and data integrity
Implement UI/E2E automation validating critical user journeys across web applications
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines for continuous execution and fast feedback
Technical Excellence
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented test code and glue logic following established coding standards
Participate in code reviews of test automation assets and contribute to continuous improvement of test practices
Triage test failures, distinguish flaky tests from genuine defects, and drive root-cause resolution
Stay current with emerging test automation tools, frameworks, and industry best practices
Collaboration & Communication
Work closely with backend developers, frontend developers, SRE, BAs, product managers, and business stakeholders to embed quality throughout the SDLC
Participate in agile development processes including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives
Contribute to technical documentation, test reports, and knowledge sharing initiatives
Mentor junior QA engineers and share automation expertise across the team
Quality & Compliance
Ensure test coverage meets defined quality gates (e.g. minimum coverage thresholds) before releases
Support regression, smoke, and release-readiness testing across test/UAT/production environments
Ensure automated tests validate security, data integrity, and regulatory requirements where applicable
Participate in defect management, root-cause analysis, and continuous test process improvement
Skills And Experience
Test Automation Framework (BDD/Cucumber preferred)
UI Automation (Playwright, Selenium)
API Automation (REST-assured / Postman)
Programming Language (Java or TypeScript)
CI/CD Integration (Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
Build & Packaging Tools (Maven, npm)
Test Automation Framework (BDD/Cucumber preferred)
Qualifications
Technical Skills
3-8 years of experience in software test automation or SDET roles
Proficiency in at least one programming language used for test automation (Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Python)
Hands-on experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow) and Gherkin feature file authoring
Hands-on experience with UI automation frameworks (Playwright, Selenium, Cypress)
Hands-on experience with API automation frameworks (REST-assured, Postman/Newman, or equivalent)
Familiarity with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent)
Understanding of RESTful APIs, HTTP protocols, and asynchronous testing patterns
Experience with build/dependency tools (Maven, Gradle, npm)
Knowledge of test management and defect tracking tools (Azure DevOps Test Plans, Jira/Xray, or equivalent)
Professional Skills
Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking abilities
Excellent communication and collaboration skills
Ability to work in a fast-paced, agile environment
Attention to detail and commitment to quality
Proactive approach to learning and professional development
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
Banking or financial services domain knowledge advantageous
Preferred Requirements
Experience testing distributed/microservice architectures (REST + gRPC + WebSocket)
Understanding of banking/financial services domain, particularly FX/trading systems
Experience with performance/load testing tools (JMeter, k6, Gatling)
Exposure to AI-assisted test generation or BDD-driven development pipelines
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
